blocks.text: A bishop of the Diocese of Marbel asked the Office of the Ombudsman to preventively suspend the board of directors of South Cotabato II Electric Cooperative (SOCOTECO II) while complaints over its controversial joint venture agreement with Ignite Power and Energy Corp. are being investigated.
